signature.name: National Museum of Tanzania
signature.detail: The country's main museum, covering Tanzanian history, archaeology and the famous fossil finds of early humans. A good introduction before any safari or coastal trip. Go on a weekday morning to avoid crowds; it is a short taxi ride from the city centre.

signature.name: Kariakoo Market
signature.detail: The city's bustling heart, a sprawling market where you can buy produce, fabrics and everyday goods alongside locals. Come in the morning when it is liveliest and coolest, and keep valuables close in the crowds.

signature.name: Askari Monument
signature.detail: A central statue commemorating African soldiers who served in the World Wars, standing at a busy roundabout in the downtown area. It is a quick photo stop and a handy orientation point; visit by day and combine it with a walk through the surrounding streets.

signature.name: Coco Beach
signature.detail: The city's best-known public beach, popular for sunset walks, local food stalls and a lively evening atmosphere. Go in the late afternoon for the sunset; swimming is not recommended at all times, so check with locals first.

transport: Bajaji (tuk-tuk) short trip under $2; taxis cheap
